request.title: Markdown normalization app
request.summary: Normalize deterministic Markdown documents through an AgentMesh App.
request.problem: Markdown tools currently need orchestrator-specific glue and duplicate parsing.
request.desired_capability: Add a fixture-driven Markdown normalization App without Multica domain types.
evidence: AgentMesh roadmap requests a non-Multica Markdown App.
request.user_story: As a tool author, I can invoke one pinned Markdown App from different orchestrators.
